definitions: The deliberate shutdown of electric power in a part of a power distribution system, performed to prevent the failure of the entire system when the demand for electricity exceeds the supply.
A reduction in the amount of work or responsibility someone has, often due to delegating tasks or simplifying processes.
examples: The utility company announced load shedding would occur from 2 PM to 6 PM.
We implemented some load shedding in the project by reassigning less critical tasks.
Frequent load shedding has become a major issue for residents.
The manager's load shedding strategy improved team morale.
